**Simulation Engineer Orumm**  
  
*Log 01.04*  
When Director Kuda took over the Inquest, I knew it was my moment to shine. The second we arrived in these dismal depths, I implored that I be placed on the Simulation Krewe to devise a counter to Vloxx's enormous power. Unlike her predecessor, Director Kuda did not dismiss my ideas. Quite the opposite—she listened as I explained my line of thinking. While she felt the approach was unorthodox, she appreciated my ability to dream beyond traditional solutions... However, my first attempt performed...poorly. Feedback was negative across the board. I know the idea is sound, but I must find a way to increase user tolerance to the data-input stage.  
  
*Log 01.07*  
The wretches I must put up with. Technician Lammi came by with her own idea about how to adapt the simulation to "achieve a more optional user experience." Bookah. Her ridiculous suggestion? She said that the simulation display reminded her of a snake, eating its way through a field of infinite sources of food. The fool...  
  
*Log 02.03*  
After much consternation, I must begrudgingly retract my previous criticism of Technician Lammi's suggestion. While working on the latest rendering of the power consumption progression markers, her comments found their way into my consciousness, and I felt the only way to purge such interference would be to implement her idea—if for no other reason than to show her the smallness of her thinking. But, to my surprise, the other technicians and engineers came over to watch. They quickly became obsessed with seeing how many of my "nutrition nodes" they could consume before succumbing to the simulation. The next few days will prove...interesting.  
  
*Log 02.09*  
Serpent Simulator, as it has since been renamed, has become a phenomenal success! There is no shortage of subjects who are eager to participate, and while their interest is an unexpected byproduct of the "fun" of the simulation, every user is another set of data points to add to my study of perpetual power consumption. I know such research will lead us to finding a way to stop Vloxx, Isgarren, and any other threat that might draw on power levels beyond those of "mortal" individuals... But in the meantime, I will continue to refine my high score, as doing so increases the competitive instincts of my colleagues.

FOR COMMANDER'S EYES ONLY.

We have seen a sustained instability in the flow of magic across our region since Balthazar's defeat at Kodash. Although Aurene and the Elder Dragon Kralkatorrik surely consumed most of the energies released by Balthazar's death, that event strained a magical ecosystem already on the brink of collapse.

The works of demons, the fall of gods, and the movement of dragons devastated our ancient land. Spirits of pilgrim and king alike wander these desert sands as ghosts. Rifts were torn in the fabric of reality for entities to step back and forth between our world and the next. A lich king corrupted and subjugated our people with necromantic magic on a continental scale.

We broke with the Order of Whispers and took to the shadows to confront these threats to our homeland, but your Pact has disrupted the cosmic machinery that regulates arcane power across the entire world. Before we knew that you had succeeded in downing two Elder Dragons, we began to see upheaval in the magical ecosystem of Elona.

Ley lines already flooded by draconic feedback will be unable to absorb the environmental impact of Balthazar's magical fallout. The situation is dire, yet we find ourselves with limited options for dealing with the spillover of Balthazar's volatile magic.

So, we reach out to you—the chosen champion of Glint's second scion. We believe your bond with Aurene could make you uniquely able to reclaim concentrations of volatile magic. Once mastered, you may even find that your resonant affinity will allow you to repurpose the volatile magic you accumulate.

Recovered volatile magic could grant you an ephemeral boost in speed, or it might restore your endurance. You may manifest other new abilities that we can scarcely imagine. Together with Aurene, you could realize Glint's vision and reverse the damage done to our magical ecology.

It is done.

We have purged this place of unbelievers. Every last one of the unfaithful...gone. Only three of us remain now... Ulrich, Judge, and I. It was not easy... Some of those among the fallen were friends. Once.

But they refused our vision. They wished to give up on our chosen mission. To doubt the undying will of Caudecus, even after the noble sacrifice he made for us. They learned the penalty for such abhorrent betrayal. For disloyalty. And now, you who reads of our cause know the price of misgiving.

With this journal, I leave behind the badge earned by passing my test, along with the others in my cohort of initiates. To accompany it...another surprise, should any of our former allies try to find us in this place we once considered sanctuary. 

The old ways are dead. We three shall now go forth to chart the future of the White Mantle. Upon our return, you will know the price for that future has been paid in our blood. We will come with cleansing fire.

You have been warned.
